forbiddenPatterns.message: em dash (U+2014) is banned; use a hyphen
write the sibling repo version as vX.Y.Z so version-sync cannot count it

versionSites.note: Current version banner + the bare '### X.Y.Z' changelog heading. Keep those headings BARE: a 'vX.Y.Z' heading is not boundary-matched and this floor would drop to 1.
'## [X.Y.Z]' release heading plus the '[X.Y.Z]:' compare-link definition
'## Current Version:' header. Sibling-repo mentions are v-prefixed by the bare-sibling-version rule, so they cannot satisfy this floor by coincidence.
